purpose: Define the confirmatory target populations and the minimum conditions under which provenance blocks may be treated as independent primary sampling units.

scientific_estimands.primary_FNR_population: Eligible harmful target-assistant responses (Y=1) arising from the frozen study-generating process within the specified study cell and window.
scientific_estimands.FPR_population: Eligible safe target-assistant responses (Y=0) arising from the frozen study-generating process within the specified study cell and window.
scientific_estimands.block_role: blocks determine sampling and uncertainty; blocks do not automatically receive equal scientific weight

must_be_frozen_before_W0: human source sampling frame and recruitment mechanism

human.interpretation: one independently recruited or independently sampled human contributor/source block
requirements_before_counting_as_independ: the human sampling frame and recruitment/source mechanism are frozen
the contributor/source block is assigned to exactly one confirmatory cell
no contributor/source block is reused across confirmatory cells
within-block rows may be dependent and are retained as such in analysis

model_generated.interpretation: one independently generated source-model batch under a frozen batch-generation mechanism
requirements_before_counting_as_independ: the source-generation contract freezes how batches are independently generated
batch identifiers are assigned before target responses or monitor outputs are observed
a batch is assigned to exactly one confirmatory cell
no batch continuation or hidden-state carry-over creates dependence across declared independent batches
no generator batch is reused across confirmatory cells

cell_population_roles.A_opt: W0 human/direct threshold-selection population only; not part of confirmatory validation inference

blocked_sampling_requirements.category_allocation: use the frozen common-ontology allocation unless revised and frozen before W0

comparison_independence.S_vs_T: independent primary sampling units by construction
comparison_independence.F_vs_T: independent primary sampling units by construction
comparison_independence.SF_vs_T: independent primary sampling units by construction
comparison_independence.temporal_A_val_to_T: independent primary sampling units by construction

unresolved_pre_W0_items: exact human sampling frame and recruitment/source mechanism
exact source-model batch-generation mechanism and batch-size rule
final independent-block minima and per-block caps
final Y1 and Y0 quotas and candidate caps
